description: This is a test class for the CustomFieldService component within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods related to custom field management in the HRM system, including getter, setter, extraction, and delete operations.

classes.name: CustomFieldServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit-based test class that verifies the functionality of the CustomFieldService class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It tests various methods for correctness and expected behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CustomFieldService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Verifies that getCustomFieldDao() returns an instance of CustomFieldDao.

methods.name: testGenerateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests the generation of getter method names based on field numbers.

methods.name: testGenerateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Tests generating a custom field key string from a field ID.

methods.name: testGenerateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Tests generating a setter method name from a field key.

methods.name: testExtractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Tests extraction of numeric field identifiers from a list of field keys.

methods.name: testGetAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all custom fields currently in use, mocks DAO responses.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenNotDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests deletion of extra data for custom fields when a specific delete option is not chosen, ensuring correct DAO method calls.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests deletion of extra data for custom fields when the delete option is selected, verifying correct DAO method calls.
